eligibility: Bachelor's degree required; U.S. resident in one of the eligible states (AL, AR, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, MO, MS, MT, NE, NC, NH, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI, WV); computer/laptop, password-protected high-speed internet, and a secure workspace.

repeatable.cadence: Project-by-project; seasonal repeat work each testing season while eligible and qualified.

maximize: Bachelor's degree is a hard requirement (not bridgeable quickly); also restricted to listed U.S. states and seasonal project windows.
